name: sudokuflow
description: SudokuFlow is a premium, Notion-inspired Sudoku workspace built entirely with pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — no frameworks, no fluff. Play, learn, analyze, and compete across 9 game modes with a clean minimal UI, smart hints, AI solver, daily challenges, and full offline support.

paragraphs: SudokuFlow is a premium, Notion-inspired Sudoku workspace designed for clarity, depth, and a seamless solving experience. Built entirely with pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, it offers a high-performance, framework-free environment that works perfectly offline and across all modern devices. Whether you are a beginner looking to learn the basics or an expert tackling insane challenges, SudokuFlow provides the tools, analytics, and game modes to elevate your play.
features: SudokuFlow is packed with features that cater to every type of player, from casual solvers to competitive enthusiasts.
